svg.title: Flui architecture
svg.desc: Flui builds a control plane on servers you own and joins each cloud provider to it with the Flui network, adding what a provider lacks. You drive it from the dashboard, the flui CLI or an AI agent over MCP.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
